title: Register with the portable long service scheme (cleaning, security)
what: Employers in the contract cleaning and security industries register with the territory's portable long service leave scheme.

sources.title: Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 31(1) (republication of 19/11/2025 (Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 | Acts))
sources.quote: 31 Application for registration by employers (1) An employer for a covered industry must apply to the registrar for registration on the employers register not later than— (a) 1 month after becoming an employer for the industry; or (b) the end of any additional time the registrar allows

sources.title: Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 7 (note) (republication of 19/11/2025 (Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 | Acts))
sources.quote: Note An employer for a covered industry must apply for registration under s 31.

sources.title: Long service leave employer registration
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this registration if you intend to provide employment to workers within the building and construction, community sector, cleaning or security industries.

confidence_note: Drafted from the law's current text on 10 Nov 2026 to fill a gap in the family (methods rule 12). The duty is the Act's; that cleaning and security are covered industries is from the ABLIS listing.

assessment.summary: Employers in a covered industry must register with its portable long service leave scheme.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
